newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-HERMIS POSTS 13.8 MLN LITAS 5-MO PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-HERMIS POSTS 13.8 MLN LITAS 5-MO PROFIT.

text.p: Hermis Bank said on Monday that its unaudited net profit in the first five months of the year was 13.8 million litas compared to 5.5 million litas in the same period of 1996.
Hermis bank posted its net profit of 27.4 million litas in 1996.
Hermis Bank also said its assets at the end of May stood at 701.1 million litas compared to 533.6 million litas at the beginning of the year.
The bank's loan portfolio at the end of May was 348 milllion litas, a 50.1 percent rise from the beginning of the year when it was 231.8 million litas.
Deposits amounted to 503.3 million litas at the end of May compared to 395.1 million litas at the beginning of the year.
Deposits by individuals stood at 101.8 million litas at the end of May compared to 47.9 million litas in January.
The share capital of the bank is 67 million litas. It has already distributed around 65 percent of its new 23 million litas share issue.
The bank said earlier it was mulling the idea of selling the remaining shares in the new issue to a foreign investor, possibly in global depository receipts (GDRs).
